item.title: 10-year-old girl critically injured in San Antonio road-rage shooting
item.description: San Antonio police said that a woman was driving south on Timberhill Drive when a car backed out in front of her. When she honked her horn, the person in the other vehicle began shooting.

item.title: Construction begins on Congress Ave redesign project in Downtown Austin
item.description: Construction has started on the first phase of the Congress Avenue Urban Design Initiative. It will upgrade Congress Avenue between Cesar Chavez and 7th Street.

item.title: 2 arrested after dressing as construction workers to try to enter the US, CBP says
item.description: Two people were arrested after they attempted to unlawfully enter the United States by dressing up as construction workers and blending in with other workers, Customs and Border Protection said.The two people were arrested just west of the Paso del Norte International Port of Entry on Jan. 9.Officials said one of the arrested had a previous criminal record of domestic assault and would be prosecuted under reentry of a removed alien.
